name: Skrelv, Defector Mite
clause: {W/P}, {T}: Choose a color. Another target creature you control gains toxic 1 and hexproof from that color until end of turn. It can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn.

needs.proposedSignature: Parameterised keyword grants wherever a Keyword[] is granted - anthem.keywords, token.keywords, grant-keyword.keywords, pump.keywords, set-pt.keywords - e.g. keywords: [{ name: 'toxic', n: 1 }] accepted alongside the bare 'toxic'.
needs.semantics: 'Other Rats you control have toxic 1.' and 'a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1' must carry the 1. Today only a CARD can have toxic N (def.toxic), so a granted or token toxic deals no poison at all (game.ts reads src.def.toxic, and a token's def is its creator's), and the printed 1 never reaches the rendering, scoring those lines 0 on the number gate.
needs.clause: Other Rats you control have toxic 1.
